title: Affine quantum Schur--Weyl duality
summary: Let $\mathpzc K$ be an arbitrary commutative ring containing an invertible element $\varepsilon$. Let ${\mathcal H}_{\!\vartriangle\!}(r)_{\mathpzc K}$ be the extended affine Hecke algebra of type $A$ with Hecke parameter $\varepsilon$, let $Ω_{\mathpzc K}^{\otimes r}$ be the affine tensor space, and let ${\mathcal S}_{\!\vartriangle\!}(n,r)_{\mathpzc K}$ be the corresponding affine quantum Schur algebra.
